fact: The Africa RiskView end-of-season report for Chad's 2020/2021 agropastoral season, produced by ARC with the SISAAP of the Ministry of Agriculture, uses satellite rainfall estimates (ARC2) and the WRSI drought index to monitor drought and insurance triggers; the attachment point was not reached.
title: Rapport de fin de saison, Tchad (campagne agricole 2020/2021)
publisher: African Risk Capacity (ARC) en collaboration avec le SISAAP, Ministère de l'Agriculture du Tchad
